'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]], [[2026 Somali presidential election]]
**[[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***Opposition coalition [[Somali Future Council]] says [[Somalia|Somali]] [[President of Somalia|president]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] can no longer perform key presidential functions, including military oversight or dismissing government officials. They propose that [[List of speakers of the Parliament of Somalia|parliamentary speaker]] [[Aden Madobe]] serve as acting president until elections scheduled for 30 June. The president has lost full executive authority following the expiry of his mandate on 15 May. [https://www.idilnews.com/hsm-stripped-of-executive-power-as-term-expired-on-15-may/ (Idil News)]
*[[2026 Bolivian protests]]
**Several banks close in [[La Paz]] as protests intensify across [[Bolivia]], with demonstrators demanding the resignation of [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Rodrigo Paz]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-voices-alarm-over-bolivia-unrest-protests-spread-nationwide-2026-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[War Powers Resolution]], requiring a halt to hostilities in Iran not approved by the [[United States Congress]], passes a preliminary vote in the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] by 50–47 following several failed attempts, after the defection of [[Louisiana]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] senator [[Bill Cassidy]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/19/senate-advances-measure-to-end-military-action-in-iran-in-rebuke-to-trump.html (CNBC)]
